projects.title: FlowTime
projects.subtitle: Completed System
projects.description: Complete web system for managing podiatry clinics, bringing efficiency, organization, and practicality to daily routines. FlowTime optimizes scheduling, customer service, and administrative processes, all in an intuitive platform.
projects.history: FlowTime started in October 2024 and was completed in January 2025, developed by a team of 3 people. The system arose from the need to digitize and automate workflows in podiatry clinics. The project offers an interactive dashboard, PDF reports, digital signatures, and advanced features to facilitate the management of appointments, patients, and prescriptions. With a modern interface and robust functionalities, FlowTime provides more agility, security, and quality in service, being successfully implemented in a real environment.

projects.title: ThermalTech
projects.subtitle: Ongoing System
projects.description: Academic project in pairs that created a CMMS system integrated with IoT for monitoring and controlling air-conditioned environments. Allows management of air conditioning equipment, registering tickets, generating work orders, and monitoring environmental conditions in real time via MQTT sensors. Also features real-time chat for teams.
projects.history: ThermalTech is being developed as part of a college academic project, started in 2025, developed in pairs. The goal is to create a robust system for monitoring and automating industrial environments, integrating IoT sensors, dashboards, reports, and team communication. The system is constantly evolving, receiving improvements and new features as development progresses.
